text_zh: ……我觉得我能听到金属在说话……但也许是幻觉
text_en: ...I think I hear the metal speaking... but maybe it's just echoes

text_zh: ……有人按了R键……不对，好像没有人
text_en: ...someone pressed R... wait, no one's there
...lead shavings tickle... is that what tickling feels like?

text_zh: ……那个人的手很温暖……现在冷了
text_en: ...their hands were warm... now everything's cold
...may the Engine forgive our unclean touch...

text_zh: ……上面几层的祈礼……我记得很工整……
text_en: ...the upper layer rite... I remember writing it so neatly...

text_zh: ……那份条例到底写了什么……为什么找不到全文
text_en: ...what does that regulation actually say... why can't I find it

text_zh: ……深处的门焊死了……里面有什么……
text_en: ...the ninth layer door, welded shut... what's inside...

text_zh: ……想在边缘画小花……但现在手指好重
text_en: ...wanted to draw little flowers in the margins... fingers too heavy now

text_zh: ……最深处真的很漂亮……引擎在唱歌
text_en: ...the deepest place was so beautiful... the Engine was singing
